title: Fundamental SPO Operations
subtitle: Fundamental operations on RDF statements.
categories: [graph, rdf]

Exploring some core operations on subject, predicate, and object combinations, i.e. RDF statements[^1].

Given a subject and predicate, what is the object?

Given a predicate and object, what is the subject?

Given a subject and object, what are the predicates?

Given a subject, what are the predicates?

Given a subject, what are the objects related by any predicate?

Given an object, what are the known predicates?

Given an object, what are the known subjects?

^1: https://www.w3.org/TR/rdf11-concepts/#resources-and-statements
